name: nanobox
description: Linux in the browser: container2wasm/Bochs engine rebuilt with a trace JIT (memory-identical guest RAM), plus 'system node on the browser V8' sandbox pages (Claude Code / codex / agy installed from the vendors at first run). Also the CheerpX experiment (server.mjs).

scripts.test:unit: node test/wasifs-write-unit.mjs && node test/installer-unit.mjs && node test/jit-host-unit.mjs && (cd guest/nbnode && ./build.sh test)
scripts.test:bisect: cd harness && node bisect.mjs ../build/eh-nb/out.wasm ../build/eh-nb/out.wasm --b-args "--jit 2:200" --ignore-icount --run-timeout 120 -- --oci http://localhost:8093/c2w/images/codex/ --spec ../web/images/codex/config.json --oci-cache ../work/oci-cache --cmd /usr/local/bin/codex --expect "Press enter to continue" --quiet
scripts.test:nbnode-rpc: cd harness && node run.mjs ../build/eh-nb/out.wasm --oci http://localhost:8093/c2w/images/codex/ --spec ../work/hc-test-spec.json --oci-cache ../work/oci-cache --bundle-file nb/node=../guest/nbnode/nbnode --cmd '/bin/sh -c "exec /bundle/nb/node cli.js --arg1"' --nbnode-test --timeout 25
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:codex && npm run test:e2e:agy && npm run test:e2e:claude
scripts.build:runtime: cd web/native && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && node build.mjs
